cases.rule: onSuccess end stops the workflow after the step
onSuccess goto jumps over the steps between
onFailure retry repeats the step until it succeeds
cases.note: The mock answers a pet named flaky with 404 once, then 200.

cases.rule: retryLimit 2 means two retries after the first attempt, then the step fails
cases.note: The spec: retryLimit is "how many attempts to retry the step may be attempted before failing", so 1 + 2 requests.

cases.rule: onFailure goto runs the recovery step
cases.note: Whether a workflow that recovered counts as a success is not stated, so only the requests are judged.

cases.rule: a step can run another workflow and use its outputs
